figurative_meaning_bn: একটা না হলে আরেকটা; শেষ নেই
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সবসময় একটা-না-একটা অজুহাত থাকে কাজ না করার জন্য।
example_sentences_in_english: He always has one excuse or another for not doing the work.
In life, one problem or another keeps coming up.
note: Commonly used in spoken Bengali to denote endless succession, especially of excuses or troubles.
